view: SmolVLM2 image processor output (512x512, no splitting), rounded back to uint8; K0 with 16x16 blocks = the encoder's 32x32 patch grid

conventions.time: frame index / 24; frames used as decoded (missing timestamp slots not filled)
conventions.steady: mean keep over counted samples, first sample (reference init) excluded; clips weighted equally
conventions.with_first: first sample counted as a full frame
conventions.cost: full-frame equivalents per second of video = mean keep x fps
conventions.sample_hist: per-sample keep, pooled over clips, 20 bins of 0.05 on [0, 1]
caveats: repeated frames lower the 24 fps per-sample mean slightly: dropping repeated samples raises moving from 42.7% to 45.0% (threshold 8; 5.1% of pairs repeat) and hover from 27.4% to 27.7% in the 32 hover clips where repeats are measurable (1.3% repeat); lower rates are less affected
thresholds 1-2 are mostly codec noise on still footage
pixel proxy: no link to encoder output error yet (needs token-level traces)
